not_chosen: vendor a schema validator into the repository
install a new dependency during this phase
treat schema validation as GMUT evidence
rationale: The local environment already exposes a draft 2020-12-capable validator.
The Python publication validator still enforces project-specific live-git, artifact-path, blocked-action, and forbidden-claim rules that JSON Schema cannot fully express.
No dependency lockfile or runtime package surface needs mutation for this proof phase.
follow_up: If THOS later promotes schema validation into CI, add a pinned dependency and a separate workflow review artifact.
